GameConditionDef.label: the breath-tide surge
GameConditionDef.description: The sea is shoving up the channels. Ground that was dry an hour ago may not be by the time you cross it back.
GameConditionDef.startMessage: Far off, you hear the tide start to climb the Salt Gate's channels. The Miasma's shoreline is about to move.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The surge weather has passed - but the water it pushed inland is only just beginning to pull back, over the days ahead.
GameConditionDef.letterText: The breath-tide is surging. Over the next several hours the salt line will crawl inland, redrawing ground you may already have built on - and it will only partly recede once the surge itself has passed.
